analysis.strategyReview: Our content strategy shows strong coverage across all five pillars with 54 published posts, demonstrating comprehensive vertical expertise and tactical depth. We've established authority in key verticals (insurance, mortgage, solar, legal) and covered essential fundamentals like CRM setup, compliance, and lead sourcing. However, we have significant gaps in advanced operational topics like team management, quality assurance processes, and sophisticated performance optimization that would appeal to established agencies and brokerages looking to scale.
analysis.competitiveInsights: Competitors remain focused on basic lead working tactics and product features, leaving opportunities in advanced operational content. AgedLeadStore.com still emphasizes product benefits over strategic implementation, while HowToWorkLeads.com lacks industry-specific depth. We can dominate searches around 'aged lead quality control,' 'aged lead team training,' and 'aged lead performance benchmarks' - topics that experienced buyers are actively researching but finding limited authoritative content on.
